Oliver Kim: Hey folks! I just landed and wanted to start something goofy — a 'Map Club' for lunchtime swaps. I doodle tiny maps of where I eat around the office and want to crowdsource the best hidden spots. Who's in? :map:
Sana Patel: love it. count me in. Wed lunch? :bento:
Eliot Tran: Definitely. I'll bring a stack of sticky notes and some colored pens. Also can do an online map for remote folks (Google My Map: https://goo.gl/maps/example)
Marin (People Ops): This is adorable. FYI we have a communal map pinboard in the kitchen — put a sticky with your initials and fav dish! :pushpin: Welcome btw :wave:
Oliver Kim: awesome, thanks @Marin! For remote folks we can do a shared Miro board too. Timezones — what works best? I'm PST.
Noah Gameboy: I can do 12:30 PT / 3:30 ET. I'll add a legend: cheap, spicy, vegan-friendly.
Zara Koh: love a map club. Can someone add a 'ramen that accepts walk-ins' tag? :ramen:
BadgeBot: Your access request (Oliver Kim) has been approved. Badge is ready at security. :unlock:
Sana Patel: also bringing a pancake recipe for office breakfast next week? low effort and very filling.
Oliver Kim: sold. pancake map pin it is. :pancakes: Thanks everyone — see you Wed 12:30 PT at the roof or Slack huddle if remote!
